floatingCard.title: Small choices, big ideas
floatingCard.body: Every adventure opens a new possibility.

experience.title: Curiosity is where it starts
experience.body: Lessons turn everyday questions into moments to try, think, and discover what kids can do.

learn.title: Explore an idea
learn.body: Start with familiar situations that make money make sense.

build.title: Try your choices
build.body: Solve challenges, compare options, and learn to trust your thinking.

share.title: Bring it into your world
share.body: Ideas stay alive in the conversations and goals you share at home.

lessonPreview.title: A lesson that invites you in
lessonPreview.body: This is not about memorizing. It is about finding an answer, getting encouragement, and wanting to continue to the next mission.

card.prompt: If you want to save for a special goal, which choice helps most?
card.feedback: A choice that brings you closer to your goal!

fact.heading: Money conversations can start early
fact.intro: Giving kids a welcoming place to practice today can help them feel more ready to choose and create tomorrow.
fact.title: Only 1 in 3 adults worldwide is financially literate
fact.body: The S&P Global FinLit Survey shows that many people reach adulthood without basic tools for financial decisions. We believe confidence can begin in childhood.

family.title: Ideas that find a place at home, too
family.body: When a child discovers how to save for something they want, the conversation can continue at the table, in a goal, or in their next big idea.
family.imageAlt: A child counts coins beside a savings jar

finalCta.title: A big adventure can start with one coin
finalCta.body: Create a free account and discover a new way to learn about money, goals, and ideas that grow.
finalCta.imageAlt: A child puts a coin into a piggy bank

howItWorks.title: Every lesson starts with a question
howItWorks.intro: LittleFounders adventures help kids explore ideas about money and entrepreneurship through challenges that feel familiar, clear, and fun.

steps.title: Three moments of learning by doing

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: Meet a situation, story, or goal that sparks curiosity.

practice.title: Take part
practice.body: Touch, organize, compare, and choose as the idea comes alive.

celebrate.title: Move forward
celebrate.body: Every small win encourages more learning and another new try.

lesson.title: A short experience that leaves room to think
lesson.body: Lessons invite kids to experiment with choices and discover that learning about money can be creative and exciting, too.

stories.title: Familiar stories
stories.body: Ideas that begin with goals, choices, and moments kids recognize.

choices.title: Challenges to solve
choices.body: Small actions that turn a question into a discovery.

wins.title: Progress you can feel
wins.body: Every step makes what kids can already do visible.

card.prompt: Your goal costs 12 coins. Which combination gets you there?
card.feedback: You found a way to reach your goal!

closing.title: Learning about money can feel like your own
closing.body: Take the first step toward adventures that turn today's curiosity into ideas for life.

technology.parentTitle: A clear picture of how confidence grows
technology.parentBody: Our learning experience connects age-appropriate challenges into a guided path. It is designed to help families understand progress without asking children to manage a system.

visible.title: Progress with context
visible.body: See the ideas your child is exploring and the confidence they are building.

adaptive.title: Purposeful next steps
adaptive.body: Adventures connect naturally, so each new challenge builds on meaningful practice.

private.title: Built around privacy
private.body: The public learning map never exposes children’s personal information or private learning data.

curiosity.title: Curiosity starts the journey
curiosity.body: A child’s own question turns an everyday moment into an opportunity to discover.

needs.title: Name what we need
needs.body: Naming a need helps separate what is essential from what can wait.

goal.title: Give a goal a name
goal.body: A concrete goal makes it clear what we want to achieve and why it matters.

value.title: Understand value
value.body: Comparing usefulness, effort, and satisfaction supports intentional choices.

question.title: Ask a better question
question.body: A clear question opens room to think, test, and learn.

choice.title: Choose between possibilities
choice.body: Seeing more than one option helps children anticipate consequences without fearing mistakes.

needsVsWants.title: Need or want
needsVsWants.body: Classifying a purchase makes priorities easier to explain in simple words.

price.title: Read a price
price.body: Recognizing what something costs connects numbers to a real decision.

compare.title: Compare before choosing
compare.body: Putting two options side by side reveals differences that are easy to miss.

budget.title: Give every coin a job
budget.body: A simple budget turns a limit into a plan that can be reviewed.

saving.title: Save for later
saving.body: Saving shows how a small decision can move us toward a future goal.

plan.title: Turn a goal into steps
plan.body: Breaking an objective into small actions makes progress feel possible.

prioritize.title: Decide what comes first
prioritize.body: Ordering priorities helps us use time and money with intention.

tradeoff.title: See what we leave out
tradeoff.body: Every choice has an opportunity cost, and naming it strengthens judgment.

time.title: Let time help
time.body: Waiting can be a strategy when a goal needs consistency.

create.title: Imagine something that could exist
create.body: Creating begins when an idea responds to a real need or desire.

resource.title: Recognize resources
resource.body: Time, materials, skills, and support are part of every project.

offer.title: Design a proposal
offer.body: A strong proposal explains what it offers, who it serves, and why it may help.

cost.title: Calculate the cost of creating
cost.body: Counting materials and effort supports responsible decisions.

revenue.title: See how money comes in
revenue.body: Connecting a sale to an outcome shows how an idea can sustain itself.

share.title: Tell the idea
share.body: Sharing an idea invites questions, support, and new perspectives.

iterate.title: Improve with another try
iterate.body: A second version uses what was learned to make a clearer decision.

reflect.title: Look at what happened
reflect.body: Reflection turns an experience into a tool for the next challenge.

confidence.title: Notice what I can already do
confidence.body: Naming progress turns effort into visible confidence.

nextStep.title: Choose the next step
nextStep.body: Every win opens an achievable action that keeps learning alive.

question.label: Start with curiosity
question.title: A question opens the path
question.body: A familiar situation gives every adventure a meaningful starting point.
question.pedagogyBody: Children form their own question first. That makes the learning personal instead of feeling like a test.

practice.label: Learn by doing
practice.title: Practice makes an idea tangible
practice.body: Short, active challenges let kids try a choice and see why it matters.
practice.pedagogyBody: A child makes a decision, sees what happens, and gets another chance to try with more confidence.

connection.label: Connect ideas
connection.title: Ideas become part of a bigger picture
connection.body: Related moments build a coherent learning journey instead of isolated activities.
connection.pedagogyBody: New knowledge sticks when children can connect it to something they already know or care about.

progress.label: Keep moving
progress.title: Every win points to what comes next
progress.body: Progress stays encouraging, visible, and connected to the child’s next discovery.
progress.pedagogyBody: A small win becomes useful when it opens a new, achievable challenge rather than ending the journey.

atlas.ariaLabel: Interactive map of learning concepts and relationships
atlas.body: An explorable map of the relationships that help children move from a first question to a confident next step.
atlas.hint: Drag to explore. Tap a node to inspect its path.

footer.tagline: Learn, grow, and build your future.

comingSoon.body: We are preparing this page. Check back soon.

families.description: A place to support ideas, goals, and learning.
